title: MVL2732 annapolis | high back luxhide tilter

spec_findings.datasheet_value: 25.5"W x 28"D x 43"H; Seat Height: 16" - 20"

spec_findings.claimed: Luxhide bonded leather seat and back
spec_findings.datasheet_value: Upholstered in LuxPlus vinyl
spec_findings.recommended_correction: Describe upholstery as 'LuxPlus vinyl' per the OfficesToGo datasheet, not 'Luxhide bonded leather'. Note: channel listings (Grand & Toy, officeseating.ca title) inconsistently use both terms, but the manufacturer datasheet states LuxPlus vinyl. Calling vinyl 'bonded leather' is a potentially misleading material claim.
spec_findings.notes: Title and handle also carry 'luxhide'. OfficesToGo (primary source) lists the standard upholstery as LuxPlus vinyl. Luxhide may be an optional grade, but it is not the datasheet-stated standard material. Recommend verifying the specific BL20 SKU finish; LuxPlus is what the datasheet shows.

spec_findings.notes: Datasheet states 'durable nylon arms'. 'Duron' is a Global trade name for their nylon — not separately cited on this datasheet but consistent; treat as acceptable.

spec_findings.claimed: Synchro-tilt, tilt-tension, 5-position tilt-lock; seat height 18"-22"; sliding seat depth 16"-18" (18"-20" on request); 7-position ratchet back-height with lumbar; push-button arm controls
spec_findings.datasheet_value: Synchro-tilt movement with tilt lock and tilt tension; pneumatic seat height 18"-22"; seat depth adjustment; back height adjustment; push-button controls on armrests
spec_findings.notes: Synchro-tilt, tilt-tension, tilt-lock, 18-22" seat height, push-button arm controls, sliding seat depth, and ratchet back height all confirmed. Exact count (5-position lock / 7-position back) consistent with Global Concorde literature; granular counts not contradicted by any datasheet.

spec_findings.datasheet_value: GreenGuard Gold Certified
spec_findings.notes: Confirmed via Global product page and dealer datasheets.

spec_findings.datasheet_value: Meets or exceeds ANSI/BIFMA standards (tested and certified)
spec_findings.notes: Confirmed.

spec_findings.datasheet_value: not stated on any product datasheet located
spec_findings.recommended_correction: Remove ISO 14001 from the product cert list unless a Global datasheet/EPD is cited. ISO 14001 is a corporate environmental-management-system standard, not a product certification, so it does not belong on a per-product spec line even if Global the company holds it.
spec_findings.notes: No product datasheet located lists ISO 14001 for this chair. Global's testing lab is cited as ISO 17025 (different standard). Could not verify ISO 14001 as a product-level claim.

spec_findings.datasheet_value: Global warrants products free from defects for as long as the original end-user owns the product, OR 25 years in the case of a corporate end user; some time limits apply to certain parts/components
spec_findings.recommended_correction: For BBI's B2B institutional buyers (corporate end users), state the warranty as '25-year limited warranty (Global commercial terms)' rather than unqualified 'Limited Lifetime'. Global's lifetime term applies to the original individual end-user; corporate/institutional buyers are covered 25 years, with shorter limits on some components.
spec_findings.notes: LEGALLY SENSITIVE over-assertion. BBI's ICP is institutional buyers = corporate end users, for whom the actual term is 25 years, not lifetime. Same correction applies to the 2424-18 SKU.

spec_findings.datasheet_value: not explicitly stated on located datasheets for the 2424
spec_findings.recommended_correction: Do not assert 'Made in Canada' for the 2424 without a model-specific datasheet confirmation. Global manufactures both in Canada and offshore depending on line; the OfficesToGo MVL lines carry an explicit Made-in-Canada badge but the Global-branded Concorde 2424 page located here does not.
spec_findings.notes: LEGALLY SENSITIVE. Could not locate a datasheet explicitly stating country of manufacture for the Concorde 2424. Marked unverifiable rather than confirming Canada.
